questions.title: String Comparison
questions.description: Which method should you use to compare the actual contents of two Strings in Java (e.g., to check if `str1` is equal to `str2`)?
questions.explanation: `==` compares memory references, whereas `.equals()` compares the actual character data.

questions.title: Recursion Base Case
questions.description: What happens if a recursive function in Java does not have a base case (terminating condition)?
questions.explanation: Without a base case, the function will call itself indefinitely until the JVM runs out of stack space, throwing a StackOverflowError.

options.text: The JVM automatically detects the loop and exits.
The program compiles but does nothing.

questions.title: Check Palindrome
questions.description:
Read a single word and print `true` if it is a palindrome, or `false` if it is not.
A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards.
questions.constraints:
1 <= length <= 1000
The input will contain only lowercase letters.

questions.title: Bubble Sort

questions.inputFormat:
Line 1: Integer N
Line 2: N space-separated integers
